text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I lost again... What do I do, 
Trainer-chan...? Maya... Maya, you see...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Guess what, guess what! It feels like my 
engine just totally kicked into gear!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
To fail at something I thought I could 
totally do! Maya's heart is beating so 
fast it's gonna burst!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I know! How about I go *zooooom* and get 
some training in right now!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
My engine's all warmed up and I can take 
off anytime, you know!?
choice_data_list:
A jackrabbit start just makes the engine 
stall!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! You're right! If I do that, Maya's 
gonna crash...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, watch out! First, we need to 
properly maintain the engine... right!

Afterward, I worked alongside Mayano Top 
Gun to prepare for her next race.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa☆ That's our Trainer-chan for you! 
Love ya!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: All riiight! Maya's gonna get serious!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna pull off some acrobatics. 
Trainer, make sure you don't get thrown 
off... okay?♪

True to her word, Mayano Top Gun poured 
her all into training... and refined her 
running to a brilliant shine!
